MemoriaHub CLI v1.3.4
Usage: memoriahub node register [options]

Register this machine as a worker node

Options:
  --name <name>                 Human-friendly node name (default: hostname)
  --concurrency <n>             Simultaneous jobs to process (default: "2")
  --types <csv>                 Comma-separated job types (default: all
                                supported)
  --face-provider <compreface>  Face-detection provider this node uses
                                (default: compreface)
  --compreface-url <url>        Base URL of a locally-running compreface-core
                                sidecar (only used with --face-provider
                                compreface)
  -h, --help                    display help for command
